review.scope: Existing gameplay report/evidence output protection and repeat comparability; read-only PS1 disc containment and descriptor handling.
checks: Directory descriptor traversal uses no-follow opens for resolved card-root and all parent components; descriptors close on normal and rejected traversal paths.
Initially valid in-card symlink targets remain supported through containment resolution.

Record CLI protects manifest, observations and optional resources inputs; comparison CLI protects regular/sustained reports and all selected/unselected raw observation paths, including resolved aliases.

descriptor_inspections.method: Asserted len(/proc/self/fd) unchanged after each 500-inspection block; absolute counts were not printed.

ad_hoc_assertion_correction.initial_outcome: Assertion failed because the reviewer expected missing_count=1 for a ROM whose complete path was rejected outside the card.
ad_hoc_assertion_correction.correction: Assert the established DISC_PATH_OUTSIDE_CARD warning for a completely rejected ROM.

evidence_source: Retained tool outputs from the independent review; receipt creation hashes current files and does not rerun tests.
